question:
The following bar graph shows the profit made by a software company (in million $) from 2012 to 2018. Based on the bar graph answer the question given below. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f058bbe9019516bebfcb06bc39710513c7f74e2257134d74e12ab5f3373aca3c.png] 

What is the ratio of the number of years in which the profits are above average to those in which the profits are below average?
solution:
**Given:**

The profits (in million $) from 2012-13 to 2017-18 are:

2012-13: 300

2013-14: 380

2014-15: 290

2016-17: 310

2017-18: 350

**Formula used:**

Average profit = (Sum of all profits) /
